3770.title: Touch composer font sizing
3770.rootCauseOneLine: The inherited touch sizing is breakpoint-limited and uses mutable theme tokens, allowing sub-16px editable text.

prReviews.topFinding: Closed and unmerged; proposed minimum addresses sizing but its pattern test does not verify Safari zoom.

3770.proposedFix: Test an editable-host coarse-pointer font minimum while preserving larger fonts and user zoom.
3770.caveats: Reduced CSS harness only; native iOS zoom unverified. Full build blocked by broken host pnpm tooling; no fix PR.
